prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1261; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with a sideswipe collision that occurred while the insured vehicle was changing lanes. Our client was seriously hurt in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the policy limits for all applicable coverages under the policy held by your insured, including bodily injury and any umbrella or excess coverage, along with a written confirmation of those limits within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, repair estimates, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that no such material is altered, discarded, or overwritten while the claim is pending.

Thank you for your prompt attention to these requests. We look forward to your response.
